_comment: RANZCR CLiP - Catheter and Line Position Challenge (2021). Royal Australian and New Zealand College of Radiologists Kaggle competition. ~30,000 frontal chest X-rays in JPEG with 11 binary multi-label targets describing the position correctness of endotracheal tubes (ETT), nasogastric tubes (NGT), central venous catheters (CVC), and Swan-Ganz catheters. A subset of training images carry polyline annotations tracing the catheter path; these can be optionally rasterized into segmentation masks via output_mask=True (mirrors the SIIM-ACR Pneumothorax pattern). Test split is the official competition holdout — images only, no labels. Source is exclusively the Kaggle competition release; use kagglehub to fetch.

primary_csv._comment: Train CSV with one row per StudyInstanceUID. Columns: StudyInstanceUID, PatientID, plus 11 binary label columns. Test CSV (sample_submission.csv) is just SOP UIDs with no labels.

patient_id._comment: PatientID column is provided directly in train.csv. Test rows have no PatientID — derived as study_id for those.

study_id._comment: StudyInstanceUID is one-to-one with image filename for both train and test.

image_path._comment: Images live at <base>/train/<StudyInstanceUID>.jpg or <base>/test/<StudyInstanceUID>.jpg, indexed by split.

labels._comment: 11 binary multi-label targets renamed to clean snake_case in _build_labels: 'CVC - Abnormal' -> 'cvc_abnormal', 'NGT - Incompletely Imaged' -> 'ngt_incompletely_imaged', 'Swan Ganz Catheter Present' -> 'swan_ganz_catheter_present', etc. The default base-class snake-casing would produce 'cvc_-_abnormal' (preserves dashes) which is ugly; we rename explicitly so LABEL_COLS in both harmonizer and dataset class are the clean form. Test-split rows have NaN for every label.

separate_csv._comment: Labels are in the primary CSV.

uncertain_handling._comment: Train labels are clean binary (0/1). Test rows are NaN by construction (no public labels).

view_position._comment: All studies are frontal CXR; not provided per-row.

masks._comment: Optional. train_annotations.csv contains polyline annotations (label, list of [x, y] pixel-space points) for ~10% of training images. Each StudyInstanceUID can have multiple polylines across multiple labels. The harmonizer aggregates all polylines per image into one JSON-encoded string stored in mask_path; _decode_mask rasterizes them onto an (H, W) binary mask using cv2.polylines with a configurable line thickness. Set mask_output_dir to pre-decode masks to PNG files (required when output_mask=True, mirrors SIIM-ACR-PTX). Polyline coordinates are in original image pixel space; preprocess_masks reads each JPEG to get H, W.

bboxes._comment: Not provided. Polyline annotations are line traces, not regions; converting to enclosing bbox would be semantically lossy.

extra_init_params.annotations_csv_path: Path to train_annotations.csv (polyline annotations). Required only when output_mask=True. Auto-discovered via infer_path when None.
extra_init_params.mask_line_thickness: Pixel width used by cv2.polylines when rasterizing polylines into masks. Defaults to 15 — matches the kernel value used by the original RANZCR challenge starter notebook.
extra_init_params.include_test_split: When True (default), append test/<StudyInstanceUID>.jpg rows with NaN labels and split='test'. When False, only train rows are emitted.

custom_preprocessing: Polyline rasterization: each annotation row's 'data' column is a stringified list of [x, y] pairs. Aggregate per StudyInstanceUID into a JSON list-of-lists, store in mask_path. _decode_mask uses cv2.polylines(img, [pts], isClosed=False, color=1, thickness=mask_line_thickness) to draw each polyline onto a zero (H, W) mask. Train rows from train.csv have split='train'; test rows are listed by directory walk over <base>/test/ with split='test' and NaN labels. EXTRA_OUTPUT_COLS=['split'] preserves the split column on the harmonized output.
